## Notes

- William Green died June 25, 1863 in Bedford Co.
- William Green married Sarah Phillips Apr. 22, 1811, Bedford Co.
- 1850-1855 Wiliiam Green lived in Bedford Co.
- In 1871, Sarah Phillips Green lived in Bedford Co.
- William Green enlisted Sept. 24, 1813 and was discharged Dec. 29, 1813
- He was a Sergeant in Capt. John B. Dempsey's Tenn. mil.
